public_sources.title: Exact McNemar's test / exact conditional binomial formulation
public_sources.relevance: After conditioning on the total discordant count b+c, the oriented discordant count is Binomial(b+c, 1/2) under the McNemar null; concordant cells do not enter the exact test.

public_sources.title: Safe testing
public_sources.relevance: Products of predictable conditional e-variables preserve type-I error under optional continuation/stopping; the relevant filtration must include all information used to choose the next factor.

public_sources.title: LLM-42: Enabling Determinism in LLM Inference with Verified Speculation
public_sources.relevance: Systems precedent for a fast nondeterministic path plus fixed-shape verification and rollback before commit; current work asks whether evaluation needs full token equality or only equality of the decision-relevant statistic.

public_sources.title: Beyond Reproducibility: Token Probabilities Expose Large Language Model Nondeterminism
public_sources.relevance: GPU execution can yield nondeterministic token probabilities and generated text even under nominally deterministic settings, motivating verification contracts that distinguish raw-output mismatch from evaluation-relevant mismatch.

public_sources.title: BEAVER: An Efficient Deterministic LLM Verifier
public_sources.relevance: Adjacent evidence that deterministic sound verification of model-output constraints can be substantially different from empirical sampling, while not directly proving the paired-sign contract derived here.

main_result.title: For paired binary sign/e-process evaluation, the minimal reusable exact verifier contract is equality of the oriented ternary discordance statistic, not raw output or even both binary score bits.

decision_sufficient_statistic.terminology_guard: This is decision-sufficiency/pathwise sufficiency for the configured evaluation policy, not Fisher-Neyman likelihood sufficiency.
decision_sufficient_statistic.setup: For task t, a frozen deterministic scorer maps canonical candidate/incumbent raw outputs to binary correctness bits C_t,I_t in {0,1}. Define Z_t=C_t-I_t in {-1,0,+1}: +1=candidate-only success, -1=incumbent-only success, 0=concordant. Fast-path outputs induce corresponding tilde variables.
decision_sufficient_statistic.pathwise_identity_theorem: Assume task identity/reveal order and exogenous pre-task covariates are frozen independently of unverified outputs. Assume every bet, continuation/stopping rule, and commit rule is a predictable function only of past verified Z values and frozen exogenous metadata, with concordant Z=0 treated as the neutral paired outcome. If tilde Z_t = Z_t for every statistically revealed task, then the entire evidence process, running discordant counts, stopping index, and final commit/noncommit decision are pathwise identical to the canonical evaluation.
decision_sufficient_statistic.proof_sketch: Induct on revealed task index. Equal verified histories imply the same predictable next bet/continuation choice. Equality of the next Z makes the same evidence factor and count update. Therefore histories remain equal, so all later choices and the stopping/decision event coincide.
decision_sufficient_statistic.minimality_for_current_policy_class: No strict coarsening of {-1,0,+1} preserves every admissible paired-sign policy. A valid one-step sign factor such as e(+1)=1.5, e(-1)=0.5, e(0)=1 distinguishes every pair of the three states. Therefore any map merging two states changes some allowed e-process or McNemar decision. The four-state bit pair (00,01,10,11) is not minimal because 00 and 11 are indistinguishable to paired-sign/McNemar evidence.
decision_sufficient_statistic.terminal_only_exception: For a truly fixed-horizon terminal exact McNemar decision with no adaptive stopping/task selection and no reuse of pathwise evidence, equality of the final oriented discordant counts (B=#(+1), C=#(-1)) is sufficient; preserving the full per-task Z sequence is stronger than necessary. This exception should not be used for anytime/curtailed evaluation.

levels.preserves: everything downstream that is a deterministic function of the raw outputs

levels.oververification_relative_to_sign: rejects canonical 00 <-> fast 11 and canonical 11 <-> fast 00 even though both are Z=0 and contribute identically to McNemar/sign evidence

levels.preserves: all current paired-sign e-process and McNemar evidence under the theorem assumptions
levels.status: minimal reusable exact per-task contract for the current policy class

levels.warning: not composable with optional stopping, curtailment, adaptive selection, or pathwise auditing

definitions.r_raw: P(fast raw pair != canonical raw pair)

oververification_algebra.exact_gap_identity: For binary paired scores, r_bits-r_sign equals the probability mass of concordant-subtype swaps 00<->11. The additional gap r_raw-r_bits is raw/token/text variation that leaves both binary scores unchanged.
oververification_algebra.rollback_savings: Moving from full-output equality to exact sign equality reduces rollback probability by r_raw-r_sign. Relative rollback reduction, when r_raw>0, is 1-r_sign/r_raw.
oververification_algebra.illustrative_only: If raw mismatch were 20% and only 25% of raw mismatches changed Z, full-output equality would roll back 20% while exact sign verification would roll back 5%, a 75% rollback reduction. This is algebraic illustration, not a live-system measurement.

observer_closure_and_stateful_extension.rule: Z alone is sufficient only if no unverified raw-output-derived variable can influence the statistical filtration, future task identity, environment state, bet selection, stopping, or candidate generation before verification.
observer_closure_and_stateful_extension.static_benchmark: For frozen independent tasks with a deterministic binary scorer and sign-only evidence, the protected transcript can be just Z plus exogenous frozen task metadata.
observer_closure_and_stateful_extension.interactive_agent: If outputs change environment state or future observations, the exact contract must also preserve the decision-relevant next-state transition. A generic per-step protected transcript is T_t=(evidence_increment, evaluator/control state update). Equality of Z without state-transition equality is not enough.
observer_closure_and_stateful_extension.time_and_deadline: If a non-anytime-valid procedure uses completion time or deadline-based inclusion, timing/inclusion becomes part of the decision transcript. An anytime-valid e-process can tolerate externally imposed stopping only when its filtration conditions remain valid.
observer_closure_and_stateful_extension.scorer_randomness: If the scorer/judge itself is stochastic, checking that two stochastic judge calls happened to output the same bit is not an exact statistic proof. Exact sign verification requires a frozen deterministic scoring harness or a separately sound verifier; otherwise the residual verifier risk returns to the probabilistic V_verify path.

steps: Freeze task instance, candidate/incumbent logical attempt identities, scorer/harness version, and statistical reveal order.
Run fast physical executions, but quarantine raw outputs from the evaluator and any adaptive proposal logic.
Obtain or soundly certify the canonical oriented statistic Z* for both sides under the frozen scorer contract.
Compute the fast oriented statistic tilde Z with the same scorer contract and compare tilde Z==Z*.

If equal, reveal only the verified decision transcript needed by the evaluator. If unequal or unverifiable, reveal canonical statistic or mark unresolved according to a predeclared fail-closed policy.
Log raw mismatch, bit-pair mismatch, sign mismatch, verifier runtime, rollback/unresolved, and scorer-generation identifiers separately.
verify_before_reveal_protocol.implementation_warning: This contract can reduce what must be proven and reduce rollback frequency, but it does not automatically reduce verification compute. Some tasks may still require a full canonical execution to establish Z exactly.

required_validity_checks: pathwise equality of evidence wealth/counts under accepted sign matches
no unverified raw-output side channel into proposal/scheduling/statistical selection
scorer determinism or separately budgeted verifier risk
measurement_plan.primary_comparison: full-output verify-before-reveal vs exact sign-statistic verify-before-reveal under identical task set, logical attempts, scoring harness, and reveal order

new_measurement_validity_rules: For a fixed evaluation policy, verify the smallest exact decision transcript that closes all downstream observers; do not default to raw-output equality when the test only consumes a coarser statistic.
For paired binary sign/McNemar evaluation, use oriented ternary Z in {-1,0,+1} as the minimal reusable per-task exact contract, unless another output-derived variable affects the decision process.
Do not require both marginal score bits to match when the only decision statistic is paired sign: 00 and 11 are intentionally equivalent for McNemar/sign evidence.
Do not use terminal aggregate-count equivalence as a shortcut when there is optional stopping, curtailment, adaptive task selection, or future reuse of pathwise evidence.
Exact statistic preservation reduces rollback frequency only if raw mismatches are often decision-irrelevant; measure r_raw, r_bits and r_sign separately before claiming compute savings.
A stochastic LLM judge cannot serve as an exact statistic verifier merely by repeated agreement. Exactness requires a deterministic/mechanized scoring contract or a separately sound verifier.
For interactive agents, extend the protected statistic to include environment/control-state transitions that can affect later observations or evaluation choices.
Capability discovery must remain read-only. Never create noop branches/refs/files as a connector probe.
scope_guards: The minimality claim is relative to the current paired-sign/McNemar policy class. It is not a universal statement about all evaluation metrics.
The rollback algebra is exact, but no live r_raw/r_bits/r_sign measurements were collected in this run.
The illustrative 20%/5% rollback example is synthetic arithmetic only.
LLM-42 verifies token-level deterministic consistency; it is systems precedent for verify-before-commit, not evidence that exact sign-only verification is always cheaper.
BEAVER verifies classes of semantic constraints with sound bounds, but it does not instantiate the exact paired-sign verifier derived here.
If any downstream consumer uses marginal accuracy, confidence, rationale, cost, latency, or environment state, Z alone is insufficient and the protected transcript must be widened.
The unintended branch is an operational defect and is not research evidence.

frontier.action: Build a public reproducible microbenchmark with deterministic scorers and repeated nondeterministic inference to measure r_raw, r_bits and r_sign on paired candidate/incumbent outputs. Compare full-output rollback with exact-sign rollback without using downstream or O state.

Derive task-specific early certificates for Z that can terminate canonical verification before full output generation, starting with multiple-choice/structured-answer tasks. Separate rollback reduction from verifier-runtime reduction.
Extend the decision-sufficient transcript theorem to stateful agent trajectories by proving the minimal pair (evidence increment, next evaluator/environment state) needed for pathwise identity.
Formalize a policy-level held-out certificate for the probabilistic fallback when exact statistic verification is unavailable, keeping the non-resetting V_verify ledger from the prior checkpoint.
Quantify how score-harness nondeterminism changes the hierarchy: deterministic executable scorer, deterministic judge via batch-invariant path, probabilistic judge, and human label.

exact_next_action: Construct a small public benchmark that measures the raw-output -> binary-pair -> oriented-sign mismatch hierarchy under repeated inference with a frozen deterministic scorer. Use it to estimate how much full-output equality over-verifies in practice, while separately measuring whether sign verification can be established earlier/cheaper than full canonical replay.
